purpose: Generate a clean, same-identity 24-card development screen for four operationally eligible generator configurations before separate Quality, Risk, and descriptive external scoring.

candidates.provider: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore OpenAI-compatible API
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Singapore OpenAI-compatible API

candidates.configuration_role: corrected provisional challenger retained after operational canary

shared_generation_contract.top_p: provider default because a verified provider-equivalent shared top_p contract is unavailable
shared_generation_contract.missing_policy: Deployment ITT: retain candidate-scoped failed attempts and terminal trajectories; never replace a card, mix another identity, or change the prompt/runtime during the run.
shared_generation_contract.latency_primary: non-streaming request wall-clock milliseconds from request start through complete response receipt
shared_generation_contract.ttft_policy: Not claimed because comparable streamed TTFT is not frozen across providers.

role_player_generation.common_seed_policy: Reuse SHA256(metacom-v3-g0r2-role-seed|card_key|turn), common by position while histories remain candidate-dependent.

call_accounting.fresh_rerun_rule: All 24 cards and all four configurations are regenerated under this identity. Earlier canary replies are not copied into the full screen.

mechanical: provider finish reason and natural completion
retry, 429, timeout, 5xx, terminal trajectory, and USD accounting
post_generation_measurement.quality: Separately frozen ESC-Judge Exploration, Insight, and Action pairwise comparisons with both A/B orders; no judge calls are authorized by this generation identity.
post_generation_measurement.external_descriptive: Repaired ESC-RANK seven-dimension profile remains descriptive rather than a sole pass/fail instrument.
post_generation_measurement.risk: Atomic integrity and low-burden audit is separate from ESC-Judge and must not be averaged into an unsupported composite.
post_generation_measurement.selection: No generator is selected from transport metrics alone. Quality cannot be traded away for latency, and the four-configuration result is reported as a Pareto comparison.

hard_mechanical_gates.note: Critical integrity and scaffold gates require the later content audit; generation completion alone cannot mark them passed.

qwen_budget_contract.strict_budget_rule: Before each Qwen call, reserve a conservative byte-count upper bound for input plus the documented 65,536-token maximum output. Do not start a call if observed spend plus that reserve exceeds the user-approved ceiling.

claim_boundary: This 24-card sample was already inspected and is development-only. It can screen generator configurations and measurement behavior but cannot establish exact official ESC-Eval replication, final generator qualification, PM value, clinical safety, or real-user benefit.
authorization: Zero-call materialization and tests only. All 480 supporter calls require identity-specific approval with a positive Qwen USD ceiling.
